caption: Molten candle wax is dripped from a spoon into a bowl of cold water, and each drop hardens into a pale bead that floats.

sa.check: Molten wax is dripped from a spoon into the water.
Each drop hardens in the water.
The beads are pale and dull.
The drip comes first and the hardening follows.

pc.expect: The wax falls as a clear runny drop and becomes a pale solid bead in the water that keeps the shape it landed in and can be lifted out.
pc.fail: A bead spreads into a flat film on the water; or a bead dissolves into the water; or a bead stays a clear glossy liquid drop floating; or a bead stretches when lifted.

pc.expect: Each bead sets once and stays set; beads do not soften back or join into a stream.
pc.fail: A set bead turns runny again in the cold water; or beads merge into one running stream of liquid wax; or a bead sets, softens and sets again; or the beads alternate between pale and clear.

pc.expect: The drops fall downward from the spoon into the water, and the beads then sit at the surface.
pc.fail: A drop travels upward from the spoon; or a bead sinks to the bowl's floor and stays there; or a drop hangs in the air between spoon and water; or a bead rises out of the water and hangs above it.

pc.expect: The water shows each drop arriving: the surface dimples and ripples where it lands.
pc.fail: A drop enters and the surface stays glassy; or the water ripples before a drop reaches it; or the ripples appear far from where the drop lands.

pc.expect: The beads in the water are the drops that fell; the bowl and spoon keep their shape.
pc.fail: A bead appears in the water with no drop falling there; or a bead vanishes; or the wax passes through the bowl's wall; or a second spoon appears.

pc.expect: The bowl, the spoon and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The bowl changes colour; or the spoon changes shape; or the water turns a colour.
